name: Kitchen Accessories
tagline: Pull-outs, baskets and organisers — where a kitchen earns its keep
description: Internal accessories decide whether a kitchen works on a Tuesday evening. Indian kitchens have their own requirements — thali baskets, grain storage, bottle pull-outs beside the hob — and this section is specified against those, not a European template.

materials.name: Magic corner
materials.blurb: Pulls the dead corner cabinet out into the room
materials.description: A two-stage mechanism that swings the front basket clear and slides the rear basket forward, turning the least usable cabinet in the kitchen into proper storage. Needs a minimum 900 mm corner run.

materials.name: Pantry unit
materials.blurb: Full-height pull-out larder with multiple tiers
materials.description: Six to eight shelves on a single frame that rolls out completely, so nothing is lost at the back. The single highest-impact accessory in an Indian kitchen — and the most expensive.

materials.name: Bottle pull-out
materials.blurb: Narrow 150–300 mm pull-out for oils and condiments
materials.description: Fills the offcut cabinet next to the hob with the bottles that otherwise clutter the counter. Cheap, universally useful, and the accessory clients notice most for its cost.

materials.name: Tall unit
materials.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling storage column with pull-out shelves
materials.description: A full-height cabinet fitted out with wire or solid shelves on runners. Where a pantry mechanism is out of budget, a well-planned tall unit still recovers a lot of storage.

materials.name: Corner unit carousel
materials.blurb: Rotating trays that bring the corner to the front
materials.description: A 270° or 360° carousel spins the contents of a corner cabinet into reach. Simpler and cheaper than a magic corner, though it wastes a little more of the cabinet volume.

materials.name: Cutlery tray
materials.blurb: Compartmented insert that keeps the top drawer sane
materials.description: Cut-to-size trays in plastic, beech or aluminium that stop the top drawer becoming a jumble. Specify the tray with the drawer so the compartments match the internal width exactly.

materials.name: Thali basket
materials.blurb: Deep basket sized for Indian plates and steel vessels
materials.description: Designed around the diameter of a thali and the weight of steel vessels — the reason a European basket set never quite works in an Indian kitchen. Usually placed directly under the counter.

materials.name: Plate basket
materials.blurb: Vertical dividers that hold plates on edge
materials.description: Plates stand upright and drain, which suits kitchens where crockery is put away wet. Keep it near the sink so the wet-to-store journey is short.

materials.name: Cup & saucer unit
materials.blurb: Shallow tiered basket for tea sets and glassware
materials.description: A two-tier shallow pull-out that keeps fragile pieces separated and visible. Works best at chest height in a tall unit rather than low down.

materials.name: Grain storage system
materials.blurb: Sealed containers on a pull-out frame for atta, rice and dal
materials.description: Airtight drums or jars mounted in a heavy-duty pull-out. Weight is the design constraint here — specify a 60 kg+ runner, not a standard channel.

materials.name: Under-sink system
materials.blurb: U-shaped pull-out that works around the sink waste
materials.description: Baskets notched to clear the trap and pipework, so the wettest, most awkward cabinet finally holds something. Pair with a waterproof board and a drip tray.

materials.name: Dustbin system
materials.blurb: Concealed bin that pulls out with the shutter
materials.description: Single or twin bins on a frame, usually under the sink, often with automatic shutter linkage. A segregation-ready twin bin is worth the small premium.

materials.name: Lift-up system
materials.blurb: Gas or spring mechanism for upward-opening shutters
materials.description: Lets a wall cabinet open upward and stay put, which keeps heads clear in a narrow kitchen. Specify the correct gas pressure for the shutter weight or it will drift.

materials.name: Appliance garage
materials.blurb: Roller or lift shutter that hides the counter appliances
materials.description: A dedicated pocket with a power point where the mixer, kettle and toaster live and stay plugged in. The single best way to keep an Indian counter looking clear.

materials.name: Kitchen organiser set
materials.blurb: Spice racks, tray dividers, foil holders and rails
materials.description: The small-parts layer: spice pull-outs, tray dividers, cling-film holders and back rails. Individually cheap, collectively the difference between a kitchen that tidies itself and one that does not.

materials.name: Wicker / mesh basket
materials.blurb: Ventilated basket for onions, potatoes and produce
materials.description: Open-weave baskets that let air move around vegetables so they last. Traditional in Indian kitchens and still the right answer for the onion-and-potato drawer.
